title: 第6章朱竹清的报复，叶寒一剑吓尿戴沐白-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    朱竹清看到三人，冰冷的眼神中闪过一丝复杂之色。

    没错，来者正是朱竹清的未婚夫，星罗帝国三皇子戴沐白。

    与此同时，戴沐白也看到了朱竹清，眼神中满是震惊，双手下意识的松开双胞胎姐妹花。

    叶寒望着俩人的表情变化，猜测俩人可能认识，而且关系不浅。

    “呦，是戴少来了。”

    “房间早就给你备好了。”

    “你先进去潇洒，我这就去把最新款的安全手套送到你的房间。”

    “听说，增添了冰火两重天的妙用。”

    这时候，玫瑰酒店经理走了出来。

    因为刚才的打斗声有点大，他身为经理，还是要出来看看。

    谁能想到，刚好碰上了带妞过来玩儿的戴沐白。

    这下大生意又来了。

    戴沐白听闻，脸色微微一变。

    经理刚才那番话，不是在打他的脸吗？

    这让他如何跟朱竹清解释。

    现在倒好，他就算是有一万张嘴，也没法解释了。

    反观朱竹清，已经猜到怎么回事了，复杂的眼神瞬间变冷，看得戴沐白心都凉透了。

    “经理，房间已经被他们定了。”

    服务员见经理要把豪华大床房让出来，赶紧把一千金魂币钱票递了过去，向他耐心解释。

    “笨蛋，我之前不是跟你说了吗？”

    “这间豪华大床房是戴少的专属房间，哪怕是戴少没来，也要把房间留着。”

    “耽搁戴少泡妞，你付得起责任吗？”

    经理向服务员怒声斥责了一句，面向叶寒和朱竹清俩人，致歉道：“两位客人，实在抱歉，那间房是戴少预定的，所以还请两位另找他家吧，下次再来，小店一定给你们打八折。”

    话落，经理将一千金魂币钱票退还了回去。

    虽说一千金魂币很诱人，但却没有戴沐白长期订房赚得多。

    “戴少，你真霸气。”

    双胞胎姐妹花见到经理的举动，花枝招展地搂抱着戴沐白的双臂，眼神中满是崇拜。

    她们知道，这次傍上一个超级大款了。

    朱竹清见此，眼神中闪过一丝寒芒。

    随后，她主动挽着叶寒的胳膊，说道：“叶寒大哥，我就想住在这家酒店，不想走。”

    既然戴沐白在外面堕落，一直都在找女人潇洒，那她也不能甘愿吃亏。

    必须要让戴沐白知道，她也可以找男人。

    为了能够让戴沐白相信，朱竹清搂抱得很紧，让自己勉强露出一丝柔情。

    叶寒感受着手臂传来的柔软感，眉头微微一皱。

    他不傻，自然能从这里面感受到猫腻。

    若是他没猜错的话，朱竹清和戴沐白应该有情感纠缠，甚至极有可能是一对情侣。

    一想到这里，他就觉得很反感，想要把手挣脱出来。

    他这个人虽然对感情比较冷淡、偏执，但当第三者，可不是他的性格。

    他更不想被别人利用，充当感情的挡箭牌。

    但是当他看到朱竹清那哀求的眼神时，叶寒突然有点心软了，暂时将心中的反感压了下来。

    万一是他猜错了怎么办。

    也有可能俩人的关系没有这么复杂。

    “好，就住在这里。”

    “经理，手续已经办完了，这间房我们要定了，谁都抢不走。”

    叶寒配合性地拍了拍朱竹清的小手，将目光转移到经理的身上。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Zhu Zhuqing saw the three of them, a complex look flashed in his cold eyes.

“That’s right, the person who came here was none other than Zhu Zhuqing’s fiancé, Dai Mubai, the third prince of the Star Luo Empire.

At the same time, Dai Mubai also saw Zhu Zhuqing, his eyes full of shock, and his hands subconsciously let go of the twin sisters.

Ye Han looked at the changes in their expressions and guessed that they might know each other and have a close relationship.

"Hey, Mr. Dai is here."

"The room has been prepared for you a long time ago."

"You go in first, and I will deliver the latest safety gloves to your room."

"I heard that it adds the magical effect of the two heavens of ice and fire."

At this time, the manager of Rose Hotel came out.

Because the sound of the fight just now was a bit loud, as the manager, he still wanted to come out and take a look.

Who would have thought that he would just bump into Dai Mubai who brought a girl over to play.

Now big business is coming again.

When Dai Mubai heard this, his expression changed slightly.

Didn’t the manager’s words just slap him in the face?

How can he explain this to Zhu Zhuqing?

It’s better now. Even if he has 10,000 mouths, he still can’t explain it.

On the other hand, Zhu Zhuqing had already guessed what was going on, and his complicated eyes instantly turned cold, which made Dai Mubai's heart freeze.

"Manager, the room has been reserved by them."

Seeing that the manager wanted to give up the deluxe king-bed room, the waiter quickly handed over the ticket for one thousand gold soul coins and patiently explained to him.

“Idiot, didn’t I tell you before?”

"This deluxe double room is Mr. Dai's exclusive room. Even if Mr. Dai doesn't come, you must keep the room."

"Can you afford the responsibility for delaying Mr. Dai's pick-up with girls?"

The manager angrily reprimanded the waiter, then faced Ye Han and Zhu Zhuqing and apologized: "Both guests, I'm really sorry. That room was reserved by Mr. Dai, so please find another one. Next time you come back, the store will definitely give you a 20% discount."

After saying that, the manager returned the thousand gold soul coin ticket.

Although one thousand gold soul coins are tempting, they are not as profitable as Dai Mubai's long-term reservation.

"Master Dai, you are so domineering."

When the twin sisters saw the manager's behavior, they hugged Dai Mubai's arms in a gorgeous way, their eyes full of admiration.

They knew they were dealing with a super rich man this time.

When Zhu Zhuqing saw this, a cold light flashed in his eyes.

Then, she took the initiative to hold Ye Han's arm and said, "Brother Ye Han, I just want to stay in this hotel and don't want to leave."

Since Dai Mubai is degenerate outside and is always looking for women to be chic, she cannot be willing to suffer a loss.

Dai Mubai must know that she can also find a man.

In order to convince Dai Mubai, Zhu Zhuqing hugged Dai Mubai tightly, barely showing a trace of tenderness.

Ye Han felt the softness coming from his arms and frowned slightly.

He is not stupid, so he can naturally sense something fishy from this.

If he guessed correctly, Zhu Zhuqing and Dai Mubai should be emotionally entangled, and might even be a couple.

When he thought of this, he felt disgusted and wanted to free his hands.

Although he is relatively cold and paranoid about feelings, it is not his character to be a third party.

He doesn’t want to be used by others as a shield for their feelings.

But when he saw Zhu Zhuqing's pleading eyes, Ye Han suddenly felt a little soft-hearted and temporarily suppressed the disgust in his heart.

What if he guesses wrong.

It is also possible that the relationship between the two is not so complicated.

"Okay, let's live here."

"Manager, the formalities have been completed. We have to reserve this room. No one can take it away."

Ye Han patted Zhu Zhuqing's little hand cooperatively and turned his attention to the manager.

title_en: Chapter 6 Zhu Zhuqing's revenge, Ye Han scared Dai Mubai to piss with a sword - "Douluo V: Bind Zhu Zhuqing at the beginning and create a god-level family"
